title: visitLogs
description: Schema for a document in the 'visitLogs' collection. Legacy collection for early volunteer visit log submissions (circa 2020).

uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the volunteer who submitted this log.

timeStamp.description: The timestamp when the log was submitted. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

Date.description: Date of the visit as a formatted string (e.g., '10/8/2020').

Hours.description: Number of hours spent on the visit.

City.description: City where the visit took place.

State.description: State where the visit took place.

Name.description: Name of the volunteer (legacy field, free text).

Contact.description: Contact information of the volunteer (legacy field, free text).

Visit_Again.description: Whether the volunteer would visit again (e.g., 'Yes', 'No').

Number_Of_People_Helped.description: Number of people helped (stored as string in legacy data).

Number_Of_People_Joined.description: Number of people who joined the volunteer (stored as string).

What_Given.description: Free-text description of what was distributed or provided.

Support_To_Go_Again.description: What support would help the volunteer go again.

Inspire.description: What inspired the volunteer to participate.

Question.description: Any questions or comments from the volunteer.
